title: Azure Container Apps Overview
description: Discover Azure Container Apps as a fully managed platform for running microservices and containerized applications without managing infrastructure.

data.text: Azure Container Apps is a serverless container platform that lets you run microservices and containerized applications without managing the underlying infrastructure. It is built on Kubernetes but abstracts away all the complexity.
Container Apps is ideal when you want the power of containers without the operational overhead of managing a Kubernetes cluster directly.

items: Serverless - scale to zero and pay only for running containers
Built-in ingress - expose apps via HTTP or HTTPS automatically
Revision management - deploy new versions without downtime
Dapr integration - add microservices patterns with one line
KEDA scaling - scale based on any event source

data.text: Container Apps manages the Kubernetes layer for you. AKS gives you full Kubernetes control. Choose Container Apps when you want simplicity; choose AKS when you need custom Kubernetes configurations.

data.title: Azure CLI - Create a Container App
data.content:
# Create a Container Apps environment
az containerapp env create \
  --name myEnv \
  --resource-group myRG \
  --location eastus

# Deploy a container app
az containerapp create \
  --name myapp \
  --resource-group myRG \
  --environment myEnv \
  --image myregistry.azurecr.io/myapp:1.0 \
  --target-port 8080 \
  --ingress external \
  --registry-server myregistry.azurecr.io

data.title: Start with Container Apps
data.text: If you are new to containers on Azure, start with Container Apps. It provides a smooth on-ramp with Kubernetes benefits without the learning curve of managing a cluster.

data.caption: Container Apps architecture at a glance
data.definition:
flowchart TD
    U[Users] -->|HTTPS| IN[Ingress]
    IN --> CA1[Container App: Frontend]
    IN --> CA2[Container App: API]
    CA1 --> CA2
    CA2 --> DB[(Cosmos DB)]
    ENV[Container Apps Environment] --> CA1
    ENV --> CA2

data.title: Key Takeaways
points: Container Apps is a fully managed serverless container platform
Built-in ingress, scaling, and Dapr support
data.takeaway: Container Apps provides serverless containers with minimal operational overhead.
